scripts.metrics: mkdir -p reports && rm -rf .metrics-tmp-cjs && node ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir .metrics-tmp-cjs --target ES5 --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --sourceMap false --noEmit false --allowImportingTsExtensions false && find .metrics-tmp-cjs -name "*.test.js" -delete && rm -rf .metrics-tmp-cjs/test && node ./node_modules/complexity-report/src/index.js -o reports/complexity-report.json -f json -e -p ".*\.js$" .metrics-tmp-cjs && node ./scripts/collect-metrics.mjs
scripts.quality: mkdir -p reports; npm test > reports/test-output.txt 2>&1; echo $? > reports/test-exit-code.txt; npm run test:coverage > reports/coverage-output.txt 2>&1; echo $? > reports/coverage-exit-code.txt; npm run lint:report > reports/lint-output.txt 2>&1; echo $? > reports/lint-exit-code.txt; npm run metrics > reports/metrics-output.txt 2>&1; echo $? > reports/metrics-exit-code.txt; npm run format:check > reports/format-output.txt 2>&1; echo $? > reports/format-exit-code.txt; node ./scripts/generate-test-execution-summary.mjs
